description: Mark a payment as a gift card purchase (gift_card) or as a service (service). Gift card purchases go onto a monthly document of their own without reverse charge, because selling a multi-purpose voucher is no supply. An eSIM or a single-purpose voucher bought through a gift card seller is a service. Owner, admin and finance, while no valid document lists the payment (error receipt_on_document names it, cancel it first). Your choice stays, nothing overwrites it.
